items.problem: CS0118 'X is a namespace but is used like a type' whenever the WinUI 3 project (RootNamespace) is named after the WinRT type the sample demonstrates (Gyrometer, Accelerometer, Compass, ...). Cost ~3 build cycles.
items.root_cause: Project name / RootNamespace equals a WinRT type name, creating an implicit namespace that shadows the type; bare references bind to the namespace.
items.change: Added a 'CS0118 — project named after a WinRT type' subsection under 'Common build errors after the namespace rewrite' with the using-alias fix and the RootNamespace-rename alternative.
items.expected_effect: Agent aliases/qualifies the type across all files in one pass instead of discovering it by trial, eliminating the CS0118 build cycles.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of any sensor/device sample named after its WinRT type, 0 CS0118 errors and the type-collision fix lands in a single edit pass (no repeated CS0118 across builds).

items.problem: CS0103 'The name App does not exist' from unqualified App/MainWindow references in migrated sample files whose namespace differs from the scaffold's RootNamespace. Cost 1 extra build cycle.
items.evidence: session-log.txt 3669-3676; fix at turn 39 (global::Gyrometer.App.MainWindow); skill-defects.json item 2.
items.root_cause: Scaffold generates App/MainWindow in the project RootNamespace; SDKTemplate samples keep their own namespace, so bare App.MainWindow doesn't resolve.
items.change: Added a 'CS0103 — scaffold vs. sample namespace mismatch' subsection giving the align-namespaces-up-front fix and the global::<RootNamespace>.App qualification, wired to the guide's existing App.MainWindow examples.
items.expected_effect: The many App.MainWindow examples resolve because the agent keeps namespaces consistent (or qualifies), removing the CS0103 cycle.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, 0 CS0103 'The name App does not exist' errors; App/MainWindow references compile without a follow-up qualification pass.

deferred_to_human: Tier-0/1 option: teach Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 / the scaffold step to detect when the chosen project name matches a WinRT type or differs from the sample's C# namespace, and either pick a non-colliding <RootNamespace> or emit a warning. Would prevent both errors before the first build, but touches scaffold/harness policy beyond a single skill doc edit.
